config.notice: 可控性实验配置，所有尺寸、质量、喷力、气量和功率均为假设；12 个固定单向喷口不是 Tesla 实车布局复原。

vehicle.wheel_model: 4 个独立被动转动轮铰链，圆滑椭球轮胎；condim=4 保留切向及扭转摩擦，铰链阻尼表示转动损耗；未模拟橡胶有限元与独立悬架
vehicle.cg_notice: 整车重心离地 0.50 m、前后居中为实验假设；车壳惯性中心随燃料质量补偿四个轮体一阶矩。燃料假设位于整车重心，惯量按尺寸近似。

fuel.mass_update: 每个控制步更新刚体质量及惯量；控制步内按该质量积分
fuel.pressure_notice: 全程 P/P0=(m/m0)^1.2，Isp/Isp0=(m/m0)^0.1；固定容积等效降压假设，未用实车罐压标定。

actuators.description: 8 个四角正负竖直口 + 4 个水平偏心口；每个口只能沿固定方向推，0 至各自上限，另受总流量及剩余气量约束

landing.notice: 允许向前滚动，不要求刹停或返回起点；连续 1 秒竖直速度、侧滑、轮胎接触滑移、姿态、角速度与接触均达标。

config.control_scope: 姿态与竖直反馈；世界水平目标力为零。航向可读取水平速度方向。

launch_gate.notice: 早期上升阶段开始滚转；阈值为质心相对平地高度增量，仍须真实积分检验低高度碰地风险。

launch_energy.notice: 5 m is an engineering task target, not a universal safety height. Gravity-only energy height and coast time are planning estimates; only actual measured apex counts toward success.
launch_energy.manual_baseline_notice: Manual development baseline selected from logged nominal trials; descent speed 4.5m/s, within existing search limits. Braking-phase angular acceleration feedforward was added as a declared controller change. Not a learned CEM result.

recovery_controller.phaseNotice: turnComplete/uprightRecovered表示正立回正；headingSettled另记航向收敛。成功仍须原接触标准连续1秒。
recovery_controller.allocator: conservative_analytic_priority; geometry-specific, not a globally optimal LP

notice: Old fixed sets were inspected across versions. New seeds were registered before generation and evaluation. No tuning occurs after this freeze. Success uses unchanged contacts for one second. Computational errors are distinct from physical failures.

baselineReuse.failureMetricWindowNotice: Reused r6 failures stop at first failing window (record=False); new formal recordings retain0.4s after failure. Success/status are comparable. Failed fuelUsed/duration/final states/peak contact metrics must not be interpreted as matched-window savings. New-seed baseline/candidate and eight development comparisons both use record=True.
